Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full thermostat payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Living room thermostat","currentTemp":71,"targetTemp":72,"mode":"cool","unit":"F","humidity":44,"statusText":"Cooling to 72°","minTemp":50,"maxTemp":90,"presets":[{"id":"eco","label":"Eco","targetTemp":78,"mode":"cool"},{"id":"comfort","label":"Comfort","targetTemp":72,"mode":"cool"},{"id":"away","label":"Away","targetTemp":82,"mode":"off"},{"id":"sleep","label":"Sleep","targetTemp":68,"mode":"cool"}],"submitText":"Set thermostat","submitValue":"Set my thermostat"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading, e.g. the thermostat/zone name. Defaults to 'Thermostat'. - 'currentTemp' (number, REQUIRED): the current indoor temperature; shown large in the center of the dial. If omitted, the card renders generic sample data. - 'targetTemp' (number, optional): the target setpoint; defaults to currentTemp. - 'mode' (string, optional): one of heat | cool | auto | off | fan; drives the dial + accent color (heat = orange, cool = blue, auto = green, off = muted). Defaults to auto. - 'unit' (string, optional): F or C. Defaults to F. - 'humidity' (number, optional): indoor humidity percent, shown as a small chip. - 'statusText' (string, optional): one short line under the dial, e.g. 'Cooling to 72°'. - 'minTemp' / 'maxTemp' (number, optional): dial + stepper bounds. Default 50 / 90 for F (10 / 32 for C). - 'presets' (array, optional): quick-set chips, each { 'id' (string, REQUIRED), 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'targetTemp' (number, REQUIRED), 'mode' (string, optional) }. Max 4 shown. - 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Set thermostat'. The customer adjusts the target + mode, then this button applies. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen target + mode when sending back. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
